generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, owning your development is what independent work rests on, whether you study sport and exercise science, coaching, management, therapy or strength and conditioning. Every study you plan and monitor, every session plan or report you judge against the criteria before submitting, every piece of feedback you act on rather than file away, is this ownership at work. Treat what follows as being about your own sport work, reports and practice, not about study in the abstract.
